formal_role: Identifies where the partial derivative is evaluated
systems_modeling_role: Anchors sensitivity to a baseline scenario equilibrium or operating condition
review_warning: A partial derivative should not be interpreted without its evaluation point

formal_role: Identifies which variables are held constant during differentiation
systems_modeling_role: Clarifies the ceteris paribus comparison being made
review_warning: Holding variables fixed may be infeasible in coupled systems

formal_role: Measures local change along the x coordinate direction
systems_modeling_role: Estimates local sensitivity to one input
review_warning: Coordinate sensitivity may not equal feasible intervention effect

formal_role: Measures local change along the y coordinate direction
systems_modeling_role: Estimates local sensitivity to another input
review_warning: Coordinate sensitivity may vary across the input space

formal_role: Records whether one input changes the effect of another
systems_modeling_role: Connects partial derivatives to combined system behavior
review_warning: Omitted interactions may distort local sensitivity interpretation

formal_role: Measures how one partial derivative changes with another variable
systems_modeling_role: Helps identify complementarity substitution reinforcement or damping
review_warning: Cross-partial interpretation depends on units smoothness and model structure

formal_role: Distinguishes coordinate change from allowed movement under constraints
systems_modeling_role: Prevents mathematical sensitivity from becoming practical leverage
review_warning: A large partial derivative may not imply feasible leverage
